name: Dirk Wahl
source:
Kia's target.

Rash and reckless, Dirk is also stubborn and quick to anger. He is a caring vigilante leader. His beloved downtown area is about to be bought up illegally by a corrupt real estate syndicate, and he fights on behalf of the people.

[From in-game profile]
